en: Hariḥ Oṃ.
Oṃ, salutation to the Blessed One Dattātreya, the Avadhūta, the sky-clad one, who is Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva; the primordial principle, the primordial power. || 1 ||
You are the soul of all that is moving and unmoving; you are all-pervading, the witness of all; you transcend space and time; you transcend all dualities. || 2 ||
You are the soul of the universe, you are the support of the universe, the Lord of the universe, the Master of the universe;
you are the stage-manager of the drama of the universe, you alone are the sole agent, and yet you are eternally the non-agent. || 3 ||
You are composed of bliss, accessible through meditation; you are the bliss of the Self, you are supreme bliss, you are existence-consciousness-bliss;
you alone are consciousness, the Caitanya Dattātreya.
Oṃ, salutations to Caitanyadattātreyāya. || 4 ||

You are affectionate toward your devotees, the savior of devotees, the protector of devotees, a mass of compassion, and fond of worship. You are the purifier of the fallen, the mine of mercy, and the remover of the fear of worldly existence. || 5 ||
You are born from the cause of devotion; you are the son of Atri and the offspring of Anasūyā;
you are the beloved of the feet of Śrī; you are the illustrious Nṛsiṃhasarasvatī, a resident of Gāṇaga village; you are Śrīnṛsiṃhabhānu.
You are Śrī Svāmī Samartha, a resident of Akkalakoṭ; you are the supreme true guru Śrī Kṛṣṇa Sarasvatī, a resident of Karavīra;
you are Śrī Sadguru Mādhava Sarasvatī. 6.
You are the one who goes to the remembrancer, bestowed by the venerable Guru; I have come to you for refuge.
Have compassion for me, who am wretched and afflicted;
even a single glance from you is the destroyer of all evil.
O Blessed One, O Dattātreya, the Giver of Boons!
Lift me up, lift me up, lift me up! Thus I pray.
Om Drāṃ, obeisance to Dattātreya. 7.
Oṃ. Let us know Him who is sky-clad; let us meditate upon Him who is the Avadhūta; may He, Datta, inspire us.
